text:
Morgan: short postgame notes from the regional-failover rehearsal we ran earlier. ran ~40m failover from us-west-2 -> eu-west-1, injected AZ drain and routed live traffic. overall worked but we observed three consistent failure patterns — logging below with owners and immediate next steps.

Ashley: thanks Morgan — can we capture owners & dates here so follow-ups are clear?

Morgan: yes. issues: (A) edge-shim sticky cookie mismatch -> transient 502s on cold-warm transitions (owner: Sam) (B) backup manifest races -> missing shard refs in nightly snapshots (owner: Priya) (C) restore runbook missing verification gate -> DNS flip happened before control-plane replication completed (owner: Ashley).

Sam: saw the 502s spike when BGP weight switching + cache warming overlapped. quick note: client sticky cookie TTL is 20s, shim cache TTL 5s -> mismatch.

Sam: plan: change shim to perform graceful connection drain + add 2s post-drain stabilization. will push canary config and rollout spec. ETA canary start: 2027-03-02T18:30:00Z. I'll attach JSON rollout in repo.

Sam: quick reproducible: run a loop of curl against edge while toggling route weight, you'll see ~10% 502s during flip. logging: x-shim-route header shows 'pending-fallback'.

Priya: on backups: nightly job wrote a manifest referencing shard-8432 and shard-8435 that don't exist in the storage index. traced to concurrent compaction + manifest writer without a lock.

Priya: mitigation: add an exclusive manifest write lock and post-write validation that fails the snapshot job if there is an index-manifest mismatch. patch -> staging by 2027-03-03, promote after 48h healthy checks. opened JIRA INFRA-3247 and INFRA-3251 for validation alerts.

Ashley: runbook: step that flips DNS didn't wait for control-plane replication; during the flip we had split-reads/writes for ~30s. that's unacceptable.

Ashley: I'm adding a pre-flip checklist: (1) control-plane replication lag < 5s (2) KV checkpoint at same seq across primaries (3) health endpoints OK on minimum quorum. will PR runbook edits + checklist. ETA PR: 2027-03-04.

Morgan: ops items for platform and monitoring: - add Grafana alert: routing-shim 5xx rate > 2% over 1m (tag routing-shim) - add a post-failover smoke job that performs sign-in, write, read across replicas - add a recurring monthly "mini-game-day" for failover drills (owners: Sam + Ashley).

NetOps: reviewed Sam's BGP change proposal. we'll update the weight adjust script to support a drain-phase hook. tentative merge window 2027-03-03.

Sam: I'll do a staged rollout: 1% traffic for 30m -> 5% for 30m -> 25% for 1h, rollback on 5xx > 1%. infra-bot please run canary pipeline when ready.

infra-bot: pipeline queued: canary-shim-config by Sam -> build#4225 started. logs: https://ci.redwood.internal/build/4225 :gear: :rocket:

Priya: backup validation will publish a JSON report s3://redwood-backups/validation/20270302.json and create an alert in PagerDuty on failure. also adding unit test that simulates concurrent compaction to prevent regressions.

Morgan: scheduling: let's reconvene Monday 2027-03-06 15:00 UTC for a 30m staging verification. game-day (mini) scheduled Thu 2027-03-10 16:00 UTC — will be recurring monthly after we close these patches.

Ashley: accepting ownership for the runbook changes. will post PR link here and add the checklist to the runbook.

Sam: accepted for shim changes. will coordinate with NetOps for the weight script hook.

Priya: accepted for backup fixes. INFRA-3247 assigned to me.

Morgan: summary of action items (owners + ETA):
- Sam: shim graceful-drain + canary rollout spec (ETA 2027-03-02)
- NetOps: BGP adjust script + drain hook (ETA review 2027-03-03)
- Priya: manifest write lock + validation + alerting (ETA staging 2027-03-03)
- Ashley: runbook PR + pre-flip checklist (ETA 2027-03-04)
- All: mini-game-day Thu 2027-03-10 16:00 UTC (monthly recurring)

Morgan: please reply with acceptance or if any ETA needs shifting. also flag any dependency we missed (storage, auth, billing). :spiral_calendar_pad:
